invariant: Prepare actual reached module body through common admitted structural syntax before guest entry, keeping active caller unchanged and retaining exact current canonical selection. Do not mutate old callable/guard or infer generated boundary.

current_route.selection: actual indexed CallExpr -> Value39 -> EnteredCall Module Arc<EnteredModuleAdmission> -> PreparedExplicitTypeArguments shared guard -> ordinary SourceCallable
current_route.publication: SourceCallable and EnteredModuleAdmission bind exact DefinitionSource/Header/Context/Body, syntax input, selection/signature guards. publish_retained_body checks actual original anchor and unowned target then atomically replaces target rows and increments db revision. It preserves source_revision, touches no caller rows, but intentionally stales old selected target evidence.
current_route.entry: live prepare_source_call only prepublishes local owner environment; held prepare_reached_module_source uses actual selected scope owner and real BodyEnvironment core, no hook yet. entered_type_thunk returns None without child BodyEnvironment.
current_route.reference: CLI retained_entry::prepare publishes actual retained syntax/body then reruns entry_function and validates actual selected body/source, rather than patching old callable. Runtime arguments/installed evidence require stronger controlled coordinator rejoin.

concrete_conflicts: CanonicalModuleDeclaration::revalidate compares actual source/header/context rows and stamps; EnteredModuleAdmission also checks body stamp and selection/signature guards. Rebinding an original module to retained syntax must invalidate old proof.
SourceCallable::revalidate checks exact source/header/context/body and source_revision. Target-only derived db revision is not caller source replacement, but ignoring stale target rows is unsound.

Existing caller installed recipe/PreparedExplicitTypeArguments/EnteredCall guards may depend on canonical target source rows. Re-fetching only a callee callable after publication does not automatically refresh already retained recipe proof.
Recursion into an already active target cannot republish body: require_body_unowned must stay. Reuse exact previously admitted target readiness instead.

existing_source_assembly_inputs.source: actual provider.source PreparedSourceView + owned_forest (actual token origins/owning editions), actual DeclarationMacroIndex.scan_handle (source/parse/path/cfg/root scope). SourceSyntaxAssembly::new uses no macro resolver/provider execution beyond those source inputs.
existing_source_assembly_inputs.outputs: prepare_syntax builds BTreeMap<(parent_inventory,parent_invocation),Arc<GeneratedDeclarations>> from source item inputs and completed nested/argument fragments; each actual record epoch/key+descriptor must appear in actual seal dependencies. Duplicate/conflicting exact producer outputs refused.
existing_source_assembly_inputs.receipts: actual syntax_requests keyed by ExpansionKey fingerprint; SyntaxRequestReceipt preserves actual issued key/site/token-root identity/definition and grammar form. attach_receipt validates occurrence/parent/grammar/source authority.
existing_source_assembly_inputs.selected_body: next_body_invocation resolves nearest actual Fn owner in retained tree; finish_for_body mints only selected original definition permit. No empty-catalog or output-count authority.

proposed_minimal_factors.api: Common immutable admitted attachment seed, with checked structural fork for a selected-body variant; new captured constructor takes actual PreparedSourceView/scanArc/seed rather than entire SourceDeclarative/DeclarationMacroIndex.
proposed_minimal_factors.requirement: SyntaxSnapshot currently exports structural events/origins but has no pinned SyntaxAttachment root/fork. Never reparse display text. An actual adapter seed/fork requires explicit bounded ownership/accounting; no assumption that deep cloning SpanStore/origins is free.

proposed_minimal_factors.api: Prepare actual per-source immutable syntax transport once at completion: source owner+scanArc+seed, shared exact producer-output index and issued receipt index, actual epoch/cfg/profile/selection and seal stamp. Expose direct lookup by actual SourceSelection/canonical target scope; selected-body preparation consumes only needed actual producer chain.
proposed_minimal_factors.requirement: Retain original and staged module sources with actual owners, generated receipt parent chain/boundary separately. Do not retain mutable SourceDiscovery, resolver/provider census, procedural worker or executable runtime evaluator. Existing output index/syntax_outputs reconstruction moves to cold once-per-owner preparation.

proposed_minimal_factors.owner: existing pure query/memo + coordinator retained input/body publication
proposed_minimal_factors.api: Memo actual reached body structural preparation by real source selection, original canonical definition, epoch and semantic dependencies; coordinator consumes result to publish current retained syntax/target rows.
proposed_minimal_factors.requirement: No provider producer execution or arbitrary native build. Missing genuine output/issued receipt remains explicit demand. Cache owns actual Arc outputs/seed and bounded checked metadata; never attach all cold executable bodies merely to finish reached one.

proposed_minimal_factors.api: Opaque target publication/rejoin step before contracts and frame mutation, preserving current caller BodyKey/site and already evaluated argument slots/effects. Fresh ordinary selected-call/explicit Type evidence must bind same actual declaration identity after authorized rebind.
proposed_minimal_factors.requirement: Do not patch callee fields/replace guard by digest or disable old guard refusal. All old target rows/arguments/currentness validated before mutation; no repeat argument evaluation. Actual changed recipe-dependency replacement policy needs source-aware implementation/control before integration.

authority_and_currentness: Actual source/parse/path/cfg/edition and expansion epoch; real seal query publication fingerprint and source lease membership.
Exact issued request key/site/input roots, actual output descriptor and parent inventory/producer/grammar join at every attachment.
Actual canonical original declaration anchor -> retained declaration header/body/context; raw scan digest not DefKey.
Target-only derived publication under coordinator, quota/overflow preflight and unowned target guard; active caller rows/lease and installed source_revision unchanged.
Fresh selected declaration proof after body rebind must preserve actual NameDefinition/canonical definition, caller site/index/source and positive/negative namespace guards.
Generated declaration boundary joins remain required; source component cannot create original-only runtime semantics.

costs.cold: Once per actual source owner, existing assembly initial tokenization/parse and real output/receipt indexing; repeated per-target prepare_syntax full output indexing/full original parse is existing debt to remove. Selected attachments proportional to needed producer chain and actual structural edits; current next_body_invocation can rebuild actual snapshot/parser per edit, separate inherited cost to account.
costs.entry: Direct owner and selected body memo lookup plus relevant receipt guards, no all-world source vector/namespace census, no installed operation source planning. First reached preparation may suspend before guest mutation.
costs.retention: Arc source/scan/pinned seed/output/receipt ownership exposed to existing input/query/source artifact traversal, deduplicated shared payload. No hidden completed-root cycle or source registry. Section32.2 caps/checks before allocation; stable domains encode actual changed facts, no pointer addresses in keys.

all8.finding: Use actual SourceSyntaxAssembly+ordinary parser/index/lowerer; legacy declarative_runtime/runtime_macro_plan/assert evaluator remain named held until real replacement evidenced.
Actual structural attachment and selected-body permit; never literal/break-only output execution or rendered text parser.
Same ordinary Value/Type/member services and canonical declared signature; no assert/method/numeric whitelist.
Original/retained/generated need real parent/source/boundary evidence; missing generated join explicit component gap, not new language exclusion.
Only actual reached body syntax readiness, required declaration closure allowed; no executable lower/check for cold funcs/arms. Nested pending function markers preserved.
Prepare shared source seed/index once and memo selected body. Installed recipes consume immutable guards; inherited snapshot-per-edit cost explicit. No repeated display/source parsing at dispatch.
Direct scope/source owner and real relevant dependencies; no world census/global revision guard relaxation. Target row rebind deliberately requires proof renewal.
Pinned structures and parser/body/index Arc handles retained; no BodyIndex deep copy or repeated file-wide syntax node search. New seed fork API must prove actual sharing/bounds.

Wrong owner/sibling source/cfg/epoch/seal/receipt/descriptor/grammar rejects before publication; generated parent gap never fabricated.
